commands.command:
set -euo pipefail

# Work only in MichalMatu/esp32_c6_zigbee on integration/c6-s3-i2c-20260903.
# Do not inspect or modify any ESP32-S3 repository.

git fetch origin
git checkout integration/c6-s3-i2c-20260903
git pull --ff-only origin integration/c6-s3-i2c-20260903
START_HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
printf 'START_HEAD=%s\n' "$START_HEAD"

# Phase 1 goal: tighten generic Zigbee identity and descriptor metadata without broad refactoring.
# Requirements:
# 1. No normalized Zigbee GatewayLink measurement may use a provisional zigbee-short:* identity. If IEEE identity is unavailable, keep the evidence visible through existing Zigbee/raw/warning paths but do not publish a normalized measurement/input over GatewayLink under a mutable short-address identity.
# 2. Preserve IEEE as authoritative identity and short address only as mutable routing state.
# 3. Persist generic Basic manufacturer/model metadata per discovered endpoint/device in the smallest coherent state structure, then populate normalized INPUT_DESCRIPTOR model for Zigbee inputs when known. Do not add model-specific branches or SONOFF special cases.
# 4. Keep Active Endpoint and Simple Descriptor handling multi-endpoint and generic. Do not introduce endpoint-1 assumptions for remote devices.
# 5. Add/extend strict host tests covering: no stable input without IEEE, report-path behavior when IEEE is unresolved, model propagation/update semantics, rejoin/short-address replacement invariants, and any new pure helper/state behavior. Prefer extracting a small host-testable pure helper only if needed; do not perform a broad zigbee_gateway.c rewrite.
# 6. Keep current GatewayLink wire format unchanged in this phase. No backward-compatibility/migration/shim work.
# 7. Update README/docs/CONTINUATION.md only if behavior/current next step materially changes. Documentation stays English.
# 8. Run the narrow relevant host tests, then all repository host tests used by CI, then a full ESP-IDF v5.5.4 esp32c6 build.
# 9. Inspect git diff for scope. Commit and push the source changes to integration/c6-s3-i2c-20260903 with an English commit message if all checks pass.

# Discover existing host-test commands from .github/workflows/quality.yml rather than inventing alternate coverage.
# Use the pinned toolchain for firmware build.

# Implementation work is expected here. After editing, run the relevant tests and full verification.

. ~/esp/esp-idf-v5.5.4/export.sh
idf.py set-target esp32c6
idf.py build

# Also run every strict host test command represented in .github/workflows/quality.yml.
# If practical, script those exact cc invocations from the workflow or execute them directly.

git status --short
git diff --check

if ! git diff --quiet || ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
  git add main tests .github README.md docs || true
fi

if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
  git commit -m "Harden generic Zigbee identity and descriptors"
  git push origin HEAD:integration/c6-s3-i2c-20260903
fi

printf 'END_HEAD=%s\n' "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
printf 'PHASE1_COMPLETE\n'
